evidence: 100% of the hotel name appears on the page

verified_facts.text: The hotel overlooks Chapultepec Park in the Reforma area of Mexico City.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located in the heart of the city and overlooking Chapultepec Park, The Ritz-Carlton, Mexico City, our luxury hotel in Reforma

verified_facts.text: The address is Avenida Paseo de la Reforma 509, Cuauhtemoc, Mexico City.
verified_facts.excerpt: Avenida Paseo de la Reforma 509, Cuauhtemoc, Mexico City, Mexico, 06500

verified_facts.text: The hotel's design draws on surrealism, ancient rituals, folklore and the energy of contemporary Mexico.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by surrealism, ancient rituals, folklore, and the energy of contemporary Mexico, every detail invites a different way of seeing.

verified_facts.text: Multimedia artist Omar Barquet created site-specific works for the elevator halls.
verified_facts.excerpt: For the 10 elevator halls, Barquet created a series of site-specific works, each a different expression of this enduring blue.

verified_facts.text: Mexican artist Emilio Chapela created original works for selected rooms and suites.
verified_facts.excerpt: Mexican artist Emilio Chapela created original works for selected Rooms and Suites

verified_facts.text: Samos is the hotel restaurant, serving Mexican cuisine reimagined with a contemporary approach and local, seasonal ingredients.
verified_facts.excerpt: At Samos, Mexican cuisine is reimagined through a contemporary lens, celebrating local ingredients, seasonality, and refined technique.

verified_facts.text: Carlotta is the hotel's rooftop cocktail bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: An intimate cocktail bar capturing the spirit of Mexico City through flavor, music, and atmosphere.

verified_facts.text: Spa treatments use botanical ingredients combined with the healing and spiritual traditions of Mexico City's Aztec culture.
verified_facts.excerpt: this urban sanctuary offers locally sourced ingredients and botanicals combined with the healing and spiritual traditions of Mexico City's Aztec culture

verified_facts.text: The spa has a steam room and a sauna.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy access to an assortment of luxury spa amenities, including a steam room, sauna, and time capsule treatments.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has an indoor pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, The Ritz-Carlton, Mexico City has one Indoor pool on-site for hotel guests.

verified_facts.text: Most rooms have private balconies with panoramic views over Chapultepec forest.
verified_facts.excerpt: About 90 percent of the rooms have private balconies offering panoramic views over the Bosque de Chapultepec

verified_facts.text: Guests can take a cooking class on making Mexican mole and hand-pressed tortillas with Chef Nayelli Caballero.
verified_facts.excerpt: Learn the art of crafting authentic Mexican mole and hand-pressed tortillas from scratch as Chef Nayelli Caballero guides you

verified_facts.text: A Xochimilco experience led by agroecology expert Lucio Usobiaga includes a ride on a traditional trajinera boat.
verified_facts.excerpt: Glide through Xochimilco’s canals aboard a traditional trajinera, explore ancient chinampas while you learn about sustainable agriculture.

verified_facts.text: Club access needs an upgraded booking; Marriott Bonvoy elite status does not give complimentary Club access.
verified_facts.excerpt: Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to the Club.

verified_facts.text: The hotel does not provide shuttle service.
verified_facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

verified_facts.text: Breakfast is available at Samos Sabores Míos for a fee.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, breakfast is available onsite at Samos Sabores Míos for a fee.

verified_facts.text: The thick glass panels at the balconies magnify the afternoon sun and block mountain breezes, making the balconies hard to use through much of the day.
verified_facts.excerpt: the thick glass panels that separate the balconies from the open air tend to magnify the afternoon sun while also blocking the mountain breezes

verified_facts.text: The Polanco district, with designer shops and high-end dining, is practically next door.
verified_facts.excerpt: The swankier district of Polanco is practically next door, with its parade of designer shops and high-end dining.

verified_facts.text: Toronto firm Chapi Chapo Design gave the hotel a streamlined look with clean geometries and floor-to-ceiling windows.
verified_facts.excerpt: with the help of Toronto firm Chapi Chapo Design, in favor of a more streamlined opulence that combines clean geometries and floor-to-ceiling windows
